prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic candid travel portrait on the stern of a moving boat in a fjord-like bay.
prompt.main_subject: An adult blonde woman with long straight layered hair, tanned skin, a bright natural smile, and relaxed vacation expression. She wears a blue-and-maroon striped FC Barcelona-color string bikini with the visible crest, a delicate gold pendant, and small hoop earrings. She holds a clear wine glass in her left hand.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered medium shot from mid-thigh to head, seated upright on a beige cushioned stern surface, right hand supporting on the cushion and left hand holding the glass. Symmetrical foaming wake trails behind, with deep blue-grey water, steep grey rocky mountains, and overcast soft sky.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Diffuse overcast daylight, soft even shadows, realistic natural skin and fabric highlights, joyful relaxed leisurely nautical vacation mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Eye-level to slightly high angle, sharp subject, distant mountains slightly softened, photorealistic high-resolution candid travel photography, natural proportions and water texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic candid travel photograph of an adult blonde woman with long straight layered hair, tanned skin, and a bright natural smile, seated upright on the beige cushioned stern of a moving boat. She wears a blue-and-maroon striped FC Barcelona-color string bikini with the visible crest, a delicate gold circular pendant and small hoop earrings, holding a clear wine glass with red wine in her left hand while her right hand supports her on the cushion. Medium shot from mid-thigh to top of head, centered with symmetrical white foaming wake behind, deep blue-grey moving water, steep grey rocky mountains rising from the bay, and an overcast grey-white sky. Soft diffuse daylight, natural highlights, relaxed joyful vacation mood, sharp subject, realistic water and fabric texture.
